pictures.name: QCR1-Two-Offerings
pictures.prompt: A rocky hilltop at dusk in the ancient world: two flat stones set side by side as altars, one holding a sheaf of golden grain, the other a calm white ram resting beside it unharmed, the valley below in blue haze. Solemn and simple. No people or human figures of any kind, no hands, no silhouettes, no faces. No angels, spirits or beings of any kind in any form, not even as figures of light, glowing shapes or wings. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
